title: leucanthemopsis trifurcata
intro: Leucanthemopsis trifurcata, commonly known as Alpine Daisy or Pyrenean Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The health benefits of Leucanthemopsis trifurcata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. Additionally, the plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and promote wound healing.
